Lisinopril 20 mg daily is listed as active. The chemistry panel at 06:20 reports potassium 5.8 mmol/L and creatinine 2.1 mg/dL. Yesterday's creatinine was 1.7 mg/dL.

The ECG preliminary note says no acute conduction abnormality; final cardiology review is pending. A nephrology message drafted overnight describes reviewing the trend after repeat chemistry; it is unsigned. The medication order has no current cosignature change.
